name: @kickside/users-ui
title: KickSide Users
description: User-management admin web component for kickside/users.

wippy.description: Admin user-management web component (tag kickside-users) mounted on the System > Users settings tab: it lists accounts with status and role, and creates, edits, deletes, and re-groups users through the Wippy host's authenticated API (the @wippy-fe/proxy api). It takes no host-driven attributes (wippy.props is empty) and fetches all data itself, so mount the bare tag inside an authenticated host; it emits no custom events of its own. The same ui/ build also ships two standalone popup elements from this bundle directory, declared as their own view.component registry entries: kickside-share (share.js), a reusable share dialog that edits a resource's access list from a config object {resource_id, access_url, share_url, title} and emits changed ({resource_id} in event.detail) plus close when dismissed, and kickside-profile (profile.js), a self-service account popup over GET/PUT /user/me whose config accepts {readonly} and which emits updated ({full_name}), close, load, and error.
